ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels in the central lobe regions and 35% low-intensity black pixels defining the perimeter and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central contiguous regions on both lobes, subdivided by a high density of dark circular and elliptical blobs (focal spots) ranging from 5 to 25 pixels in diameter. Black pigmentation is continuous along the trailing edges and increases in density toward the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 75-degree interior angle and a vertical pixel depth of 12% relative to the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire span of the trailing edge, exhibiting peak-to-valley amplitudes of 3-12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex parabolic curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, showing a sharp upward sweep on the lateral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular dark-pixel clusters concentrated in the high-intensity white regions of both lobes, consistent with localized scarring patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent bulbous mass of light-brown/tan textured pixels attached to the distal tip of the left lobe (viewer's left), exhibiting a distinct contrast from the fluke's primary pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Numerous high-intensity specular highlights (glare) scattered across the fluke surface indicating water droplet presence.
